system.description: Difficulty equals (12 - Resources sacrificed). Must be spoken by a mortal Siakal priest. Requires sacrifices worth 300 dots of Essence (no promises). Priest recites accomplishments and devotion, then leaps into the ocean to be swallowed by a War Shark. Brought before Siakal for judgment. If found lacking, she eats him. If worthy, an agonizing transformation makes the priest a War Shark with all traits of that god except where existing ratings are higher.
